reformulation: External, agent-produced exact reduction committed as runs/test83-nomf-B1/output/reformulated.mps (NAME test83r) from input/model.mps (NAME test83, 31,983,856 B): a binary set-partitioning model with 65,832 integer columns (one INTORG block, no BOUNDS/RANGES/OBJSENSE), 100 unit-coefficient E rows with RHS 1 and 959,373 nonzeros; every coefficient and RHS is exactly 1, all 65,832 column supports are distinct and the 100 row supports are distinct, and nonnegativity plus any incident unit-RHS equality makes every column binary. The target has 65,671 columns, 100 L rows and 958,559 nonzeros: the 61 strictly dominated columns are deleted (each has a disjoint two-part replacement built from retained columns with strict saving 0.161497..19.872357) and all 100 singleton columns are eliminated by exact substitution, which rewrites every retained objective coefficient as c_j minus the sum of incident singleton costs, turns the 100 rows from E to L, adds an explicit BV bound per retained column and encodes the constant C=4989.422626 as RHS(obj)=-C. Preservation is minimum value plus optimal-solution reconstruction: the certificate is a complete source-to-target NonIncreasing affine map and a target-to-source Equal recovery with 152 affine observations, plus a caller-bound improvement on P = sum of the 61 dominated coordinates whose margin 161497/1000000 forces every attained source optimizer to have all 61 coordinates zero. No solver, no LP claim, no all-feasible-point bijection.
claim_class: Two complete integer affine directional maps (source->target objective NonIncreasing, target->source objective Equal) with 152 explicit affine observations, plus one caller-bound strict-improvement contract on the complete source model. projection=[] and inverse=null in both claims, so the retained-coordinate binding is only implied by the observations; no LP claims, no bijections, no points, no branches, and the whole proof is Lin steps (no EqPair, Cases or lifts).
claims: claims[0] forward: input_integers=output_integers=true, reverse=false, objective='NonIncreasing', projection=[], inverse=null, 152 affine observations, 351 Lin steps, 197,266 obligations; map = 65,671 expressions (65,619 identity coordinates plus 52 aggregates F_j = x_j + sum of the removed columns the dominance witnesses assign to j).

claims[1] reverse: reverse=true, objective='Equal', the same 152 observations in mirrored order, 100 Lin steps, 197,749 obligations; map = 65,832 expressions - 61 removed coordinates mapped to constant 0, 100 singletons mapped to 1 minus the retained incidence of their row (958,559 terms in total, exactly the target matrix nonzero count), the rest identity.

improvements[0]: claim {target:false, integers:true, positive = sum of the 61 dominated coordinates}; the block ends in ImproveReturn with map = the complete 65,832-coordinate source tuple, checks = the per-coordinate triple, margin {'Predicate':'161497/1000000'}; 183 Lin steps, 197,597 obligations.

Semantics: the two directional maps give minimum preservation and optimal-solution recovery, and the improvement then excludes all 61 dominated coordinates from every attained source optimizer (cases/test83/README.md). No numeric optimum, no LP relation, no nonemptiness and no all-feasible-point bijection is asserted.

Obligation order is contractual and positional: the checks arrays mix step references with the literal 'Exact' per coordinate in the format's order, so the preparer hand-branches three patterns (removed column: 'Exact','Exact','Exact'; singleton: row_ref, Lin, 'Exact'; other: VarLower, VarUpper, 'Exact').

top_capability: SCOPE_QUERIES - a scope reference that claims and steps can carry wherever a term list is expected: the 24.6 MB request and the 90.7 MB RPA hold about five copies of the same 958,559-term incidence corpus, whose densest element is a single row's 25,330-term recovery list appearing as a request pair, a claim map entry and a Lin step.
notes: Answer to the assignment question: the 24 MB request does not list columns or rows, it lists row incidences. Of its 152 affine-observation pairs per claim, 100 are the singleton recovery maps q_s = 1 minus the retained incidence of row s, written as explicit unit-coefficient term lists (up to 25,330 terms and 325,019 B for a single pair; 958,885 terms and 12,311,036 B per claim, 99.96% of the pair bytes), and the second claim only mirrors the first. A scope/derived-projection claim form (SCOPE_QUERIES) deletes ~99.96% of the request, the 24,622,656 B duplicate inside proof.rpa, block1's 14.85 MB map and the 958,559 reverse Lin terms; PROJECTION_BINDING removes the mirrored copy; BATCH_TEMPLATES compresses the 592,612 obligations. Dropped as lower value for this case: WORK_PREFLIGHT (nothing estimates that a 65,832-column, 100-row case yields a 24.6 MB request and 90.7 MB RPA, but the compact forms can simply be adopted), DIAGNOSTICS/COUNTEREXAMPLE_TESTING (the 12 mutations mutate positional JSON and report a bare obligation index, yet docs/API.md already lists code plus location), and MODEL_SHAPE_STATS (support and degree sweeps are one numpy line over 65,832 bit masks). The case is otherwise structurally simple - 100 rows, 634 Lin steps, no lifts, points, bijections or EqPair - so its cost is almost entirely serialised scope.
